name: Kettlebell Skier Swing
description: A swing where the bell travels at your SIDE rather than between the legs — feet closer together, arm sweeping back past the hip and driving forward and up like a cross-country ski pole. Because the feet are close and the path is at the side, it loads the quads much harder than a standard hip-dominant swing (still hinge-and-drive, not a squat). Push the hips back to load the spring, then drive the ground away and snap tall to propel the bell forward. Single-arm here (single bell); a good option when swinging between the legs is awkward.
